Arachnophobia.description: Increases bunker spider (SandSpider) spawn chance. Allows more than one to spawn.

Barber.description: Increases spawn chance of barber and there's more of them
messages: In dire need of a haircut..?

Butler.description: Increases spawn chance of butler and there's more of them
messages: Someone is taking care of this place
Mirror finished floors require meticulous care..
Avoid stained clothing by not staining the floors. Suits are company property!

Crawler.description: Increases thumper (also Crawler or Halves) spawn chance. Allows multiple to spawn and lowers their power level.
messages: To bonk or be bonked, that is the question
Does putting two halves together MAKE US WHOLE AGAIN?

DevochkaPizdec.description: Increases Ghostgirl (Dressgirl) spawn chance. Allows more than one to spawn.
messages: Workers were losing their mind before they shut this place down. Extract what was left behind.

FlowerMan.description: Increases Bracken (Flowerman) spawn chance. Allows more than one to spawn.
messages: Something is lurking in the shadows
Are you afraid of the dark?
Sometimes you don't want to win a staring contest!

Hell.description: Increases Jester spawn chance. Allows more than one to spawn.
messages: Sir, I'm going to have to ask you to leave.
The company wishes the best of luck!

HoarderBug.description: Spawns a lot of Hoarderbugs while still allowing other enemies to spawn.
messages: Residues of pesticide detected in the atmosphere
The hoarding bug mafia is in charge of this place

Lizards.description: Increases Puffer spawn chance and there's more of them.
messages: Be aware of toxic spore clouds

Slime.description: Increases spawn chance of Hygrodere (Blob/Slime) and there's more of them.
messages: Don't get lost in the sauce
They'll only kill you when you're not looking
Now this is a staring contest you do not want to lose!

EnemyBounty.description: Company rewards enemy kills with bonus credits.
messages: The company pays you for killing monsters
killMessages: Threat neutralized! Keep up the good work. The company sends {amount} credits.
Enemy killed! Your work keeps the company happy. You receive {amount} credits.
Monster killed! The company values your commitment. {amount} credits received.

messages: Abandoned after their defense systems were hacked
The company disabled all turrets on this moon

HordeMode.description: Increases inside enemy spawn rate. Spawns enemies earlier and more frequently.
messages: No one has ever returned from here..
The company wishes the best of luck!

HullBreak.description: The company sends a bonus payment. Take a break from stressfull events.
messages:
KPI report: underperforming
You are granted </color><color=green>{amount}</color><color=white> credits. Use them to prove your worth to the company!
The company appreciates your loyalty. You receive </color><color=green>{amount}</color><color=white> credits
Bonus payment received: </color><color=green>{amount}</color><color=white> credits. Keep up the good work!
Lots of mines might block your path

Nothing.description:
Nothing happens - This event means there is no event.
Adjust weight to set overall chance of getting an event vs. not getting an event for each time an event is randomly selected.

OnAPowderKeg.description: Landmines will detonate randomly. Spawns additional landmines.
messages: Mines explode at the slightest vibration

OneForAll.description: The ship will leave within two hours after one of the workers has died.
messages: <color=white>You have been selected for team building measures!</color>
OneForAll.deathMessage: Employee signal lost! Ship will leave in two hours!

OpenTheNoor.description: All security doors spawn in closed state.
messages: Abandoned on lockdown. All security doors are closed.

OutSideEnemyDay.description: Increased amount of outside enemies during daytime. Eclipsed without eclipse.
messages: This place was shrouded in darkness for weeks
A prolonged eclipse has disrupted wild life's circadian rhythm
Due to frequent weather events wildlife roams the surface during daytime
They call this place Takeshi's castle
Locals call this place Sen's fortress

TimeAnomaly.description: Makes day shorter i.e. time passes faster
messages: Gravity distorts space time. You better hurry!
Let's go! In and out. Twenty minute adventure.
Gravitational anomaly nearby! Time passes at a faster rate.

TimeDilation.description: Makes day longer i.e. time passes slower
messages: Gravity distorts space time. Take your time!
You have all the time you need.
Gravitational anomaly distorts spacetime! Time passes at a slower rate.
Keep moving from cover to cover!
The company recommends bringing a bulletproof vest!

Armday.description: Spawns a lot of heavy loot.
messages: Expect a lot of big heavy scrap!
Grip strength required! Heavy duty scrap.
Slipped disks are not covered by company insurance!
Lift heavy objects with a jerking twisting motion!

BabkinPogreb.description: Spawns a lot of pickle jars.
messages: Scans indicate all scrap is.. organic?
There is something wrong with the scrap..
The Company wishes a Merry Christmas!

Clownshow.description: Spawns a lot of noisy scrap.

DayDrinking.description: Spawns a lot of alcoholic beverages.
messages: Let's crack a beer or two!
Alcohol use prohibited during work hours!
There is something wrong with the scrap..

Easter.description: Spawns a lot of easter eggs.
messages: Help the Easter bunny collect the Easter eggs!

LuckyDay.description: Increases spawn chance of high value loot.
messages: Supposed to hold some very valuable scrap

SelfDefense.description: Spawns a lot of scrap that can be utilized as weapon.

Boomba.description: Increases spawn chance of Boomba and there's more of them. Also spawns more landmines.
messages: Lots of mines and some.. are moving?

Herobrine.description: Guarantees Herobrine spawn. Herobrine doesn't reduce the amount of other enemies (doesn't add to global power)

Meltdown.description: Starts reactor meltdown sequence sometime during the day.
messages: Unstable reactor core. Extract and leave immediately!
Elevated radiation levels. Reactor meltdown imminent!
Prevent a nuclear disaster by gracefully removing the apparatus core
Increased radiation levels. Don't wander too far off the ship.

AC_Bunny.description: Increases spawn chance of the unique bunny ears item (AdvancedCompany)

AC_Controller.description: Increases spawn chance of the green Pietsmiet controller item (AdvancedCompany)
messages: The only thing they fear is you

AC_RGBShoes.description: Increases spawn chance of the unique light shoes item (AdvancedCompany)
messages: Run at the speed of light
Reports of RGB lights.. traveling at extreme speeds

PrisonMine.description: Spawns additional cage/prison mines inside. Uses TurretScale config.
messages: Cages used to trap wildlife are stored here

GiftMimic.description: Spawns additional GiftMimics inside. Uses LandmineScale config divided by 3.
messages: Is this a gift.. for me?

PropulsionMine.description: Spawns additional propulsion mines inside. Uses LandmineScale config.

InvisibleGuest.description: Increases SCP966 spawn frequency. Spawns up to three.

RottingMan.description: Increases SCP106 spawn frequency and can spawn more of them.
messages: Stay away from any elderly 'rotting' humanoids..
No physical interaction with SCP-106 is allowed at any time.

ShyGuy.description: Increases spawn chance of Shy Guy. Allows more than one to spawn.
messages: When you're scared to take a look..
No one who's seen their face has survived..

SlimyFriend.description: Increases spawn chance of SCP-999 and there's more of them.
messages: Large, amorphous, gelatinous mass of translucent orange slime
Inhabited by seemingly playful - dog-like - creature.

BruceAlmighty.description: Increases Bruce spawn frequency. Spawns up to three.
messages: The land animals won't harm you.. unless you present yourself as food

SeaMine.description: Spawns additional seamines inside. Uses LandmineScale config.
messages: Lots of mines might block your path

Urchin.description: Increases Urching spawn frequency. Spawns up to ten early.

desc.EventCount: Maximum number of active events. Less are possible depending on NothingEvent's weight.
desc.IncreaseEventCountPerDay:
Whether to increase EventCount by one for each day passed. Resets when a new quota begins.
Setting this to "true" and EventCount to n will roll n events on the first day, n+1 on the second, ..
desc.UseUniqueChatMessages: If true will use non ambigous messages in chat. Every event has a unique message that doesn't change.
desc.UseColoredChatMessages: If true will use colors for event messages to indicate whether they are 'good' or 'bad' events.
desc.LandmineScale: The amount of additional landmines spawned by landmine event (there are more events that spawns mines and thus scale with the value set here)
desc.TurretScale: The amount of additional turrets spawned by turret event
desc.SpikeTrapScale: The amount of additional spike traps spawned by SpikeTrap event
desc.BountyRewardMin: Minimum amount of credits rewarded for killing an enemy during EnemyBountyEvent
desc.BountyRewardMax: Maximum amount of credits rewarded for killing an enemy during EnemyBountyEvent
desc.BountyRewardLimit:
Limits the number of times you can get rewarded for kills during EnemyBountyEvent. Final reward will always pay `BountyRewardMax` * 1.5
Set this to 0 for unlimited number of rewards.
desc.HullBreakEventCreditsMin: Minimum amount of credits granted by HullBreakEvent
desc.HullBreakEventCreditsMax: Maximum amount of credits granted by HullBreakEvent
desc.LevelSettings:
Specifies the settings to apply to every level by default
These are baseline settings. Changes by events will always apply on top.
'vanilla': keep level settings as they are
'hullbreaker': hard difficulty. Significantly increases spawn rate inside and outside. Increases max power of inside and outside nemies by 16 and 20 respectively
'custom': uses the values you specified below. Defaults for 'custom' are the values used in 'hullbreaker'
desc.MaxEnemyPowerCount: Increase max enemy power count by this value
desc.MaxOutsideEnemyPowerCount: Increase max outside enemy power count by this value (e.g. moutdog or forestgiant)
desc.MaxDaytimeEnemyPowerCount: Increase max daytime enemy power count by this value (e.g. bees)
desc.SpawnCurveOverride: Change spawn rate for inside enemies. A value of '256' will max out the amount of monsters spawned in each spawn wave starting as soon as you land.
